profile.headline: Software Engineer en Schlumberger
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with extensive knowledge in the information technology and services industry. Key skills:
Golang, Python, Bash Script, MySQL, network programming (TCP/IP, UDP...), multithreaded programming, QT framework. Cloud services, such as AW cloud. DevOps including Docker, Debugging tools: Wireshark, UART

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned end to end production of all electronic chassis’ in the resistivity tool line
• Managed electrical development of tools according to monthly production demand
• Identified root cause of failures by troubleshooting electroncis via system test and golden tools
• Employed SAP to track the build status and quality of each tool
• Drafted workflow documents detailing process for specific tools

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: then used charts and pivot tables to perform an extensive analysis of the data using graphs, charts and pivot tables. After completing the analysis, I distributed the results using Microsoft Office. By doing this I was able to track the speed and performance rate of the staff. Upon completion of the internship, I gave a final presentation at the academy of science and engineering fair. Time management, public speaking and proficiency in Excel were skills gained through this internship.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a technical program manager at Intel I defined and developed the HW sku stack, build plan and schedule for a product in the new business development organization. I then led a weekly customer support forum to present hardware ordering options, address and mitigate risks, as well as update internal customers on the hardware status. I also collected and scrubbed product demand, as well as tracked and managed deployment and allocation at every stage of the product life cycle. In addition to my to my role as a TPM, I managed the execution of an internal audit, created ramp plans for new hires and recent college graduates, and represented the Data Center Engineering Group at several recruiting events including career fairs and NSBE conferences.

volunteerExperiences.role: Assist in the Sorting and Packaging of Food
volunteerExperiences.description: The Oregon Food Bank is an organization that strives to end hunger. Once a quarter I spend 2-3 hours at the Oregon Food Bank packing the food of the day. At the end of the 2-3 hours volunteers are told how many pounds of food they packaged and how many families were fed as a result off their service

Women are worthy is an organization that encourages women to maximize their homes, jobs, communities and places of worship. Throughout the year this organization host various seminars that allow women to mingle, share experiences and encourage one another.
